scenes.summary: You follow the Ink Spirit and found the second scroll. It leads to a quiet little village named Pan'an.

lines.text: If you want to find out, then please open the way, Endministrator.
...What a lively place.
I'd rather have this cacophony. It's more comforting than the noises of war.
This painting depicted that special village you mentioned, right?
Yes. Pan'an. A common hamlet far enough from the frontlines.
Before coming here, I spent nearly all my time on Nuli's back and roamed the lands. I had never stayed at a place like this.
So I made quite a few mistakes while I rested and healed.
Now that just made me very curious.
A gravely wounded young man who happened to be an Imperial Guards veteran... I wonder what could've happened to him in a peaceful village like this...?

options: I still have to take care of something...

scenes.summary: A decade past, Ye Minghe awoke bathed in blood, his mind still bound to the war zone, stubbornly obsessed with gripping a blade once more.

lines.text: You're awake? Wait, Mister Minghe, just lie down and rest —
Where ... am I? Who ... are you?
This is Pan'an Village. A place where you can rest and heal in peace.
The retreat ... the Aggelos... I... What happened...? What about everything else?
It's ... bright... Why am I...
Calm down! The HAS evac was a success. The Aggelos is no more. As for you —
I'm still alive. I gotta rendezvous with my comrades...
I could've done more. The expedition ... it's not over yet... I must...
You should rest and recuperate! The injuries are heavy. They would take a year and a half to mend.
My spear... My sword...

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe sees you from the past. The difficult battle has made a young Ye doubt his skills and he wants to learn the fighting technique you used to save him. But you advise him to stay at Pan'an Village and promise that when he meets you again, he would have learned the actual power he seeks to have.

lines.text: Hngh...
Don't push yourself too hard, or you may never be able to fight again.
You're finally here! I've never had such a difficult patient. He just wouldn't listen.
Carry on, surgeon. Let me have a moment with Minghe.
Endministrator...
You can't even handle a sword properly. That must've felt terrible.
I've heard about your feats, Endministrator of Endfield Industries. You have averted disaster on countless occasions... I have longed to meet you in person.
But I never expected ... it would happen in a place like that.
May I ask you a question?
How do I unleash that strike of yours?
When I ran into you, you were covering the rear all by yourself. You took out numerous Ankhors. Aggeloid carcasses piled up all around.
"HAS prodigy", "the young and eternal frontline soldier"... You've already lived up to everyone's expectations.
With mastery comes recognition, and with recognition comes greater responsibility.
But I am not skilled enough, and my sword lacks a true edge. Had you not shown up, I would've been overpowered by the Aggeloid host...
If I had your strength...
You don't need to be someone like me.
My blade might not ... be a good fit for you.
Our lives may differ, but disasters come for all of us. So, what about the surgeon who healed you, or the burdenbeast farmer in the field?
Tell me. Should they also learn how to wield a blade like me?
Sometimes ... people only have insignificant things like this.
Endmin, I might know what you're saying, but...
You'll figure it out. Before that happens, just stay here and let yourself recover.
The villagers have agreed to accommodate you. As for HAS, I'll notify them as well.
You're leaving? You saved my life ... but I, I haven't even thanked you yet.
Save that for the future.
The future?
Yes. There may come a day when even a twig like this becomes the sword you truly want.
Tianshi Tan has an eye for people... And I trust my own judgment as well.
We will meet again. When that day comes, give me your answer... Let this be our promise.
Go and find your companion. She doesn't like other people that much.

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe finds Nuli and found that the gallopbeast is genuinely enjoying village life. To keep himself occupied, Ye Minghe asks Mu Xing, a young herdsboy, to find him some work.

lines.text: So you're the owner of this black beast? Hurry, tell me how to make it behave!
While you slept, your beast kept chasing my burdos around! It even shot scary lightning! Now my burdos won't go into their pens...
Hi there. I'm Mu Xing! The burdo-master of this village!
Ye Minghe.
I'm sorry.
Nuli spent many years in the military with me. She was rarely around burdenbeasts. The change may have left her confused...
(Unhappily shakes her neck)
You were having fun with the burdenbeasts?
(Nods with approval)
You like it here?
(Nods with approval)
Haha, Mister Minghe. Seems to me you're the one who's confused.
Mu Xing, is there anything I could do for the village?
Wha? Why so sudden?
Hmm. Mister surgeon did say you're super strong and ain't gonna die no more. But isn't this a little quick to start proving yourself?
I'm not proving anything.
The one who brought me here said I should stay in the village. It's got the answers I need.
But that battlefield still haunts me ... and so do the Aggelos I couldn't defeat... I can't help but keep questioning myself...
Ah ... I see. You want to keep yourself busy, so you don't dwell on it.
Take this as my apology for the trouble Nuli caused.
Okay, I accept... You'll be coming with me.

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe helps Lulu the carpenter repair a burdenbeast pen.

lines.text: Ugh. I should've asked for extra hands...
Mister Minghe? I thought you're wounded... You should be resting...
Hey there, Lulu, your help's here!
I'm better now. Anything I can do to help?
Let him help out, Lulu. His body's healed up, but he's still got a serious thinking problem.
Fine.
Mister Minghe, know anything about repairing beast pens?
I ... I'll learn on the job.

scenes.summary: After cleaning the burdo-muck, Mu Xing starts asking Ye Minghe about the future. Ye faces the same questions and has no answers for the herdsboy. But after a day of hard work, he decides to leave those issues for later.

lines.text: Mmmph ... Finally cleared up the muck!
So what happened back then? Did I pat it too hard? Did it eat something wrong?
Neither! It's constipation! We just unplugged its butty hole!
That burdo's got digestive problems. The meds weren't working, but I discovered that tartpepper might help...
So I gathered tartpeppers and fed it some. It didn't react so I thought it wasn't working. Turned out that I needed more peppers —
Wow, Mister. Are you memorizing everything I said?
To be honest, I thought I was talented in many things. Spears. Swords. Military strategies. I learned them easily.
But building beast pens and rearing burdos... They're hard.
Perhaps ... it's because I never treated them as part of my responsibility...
Come on, it's not about responsibility. Whatever you do, it takes heart to do it well.
Mister Minghe, can you ... teach me martial arts?
Everyone says you're super powerful, and a young Imperial Guards reservist. Even the legendary Endmin said you're awesome...
Heheh... Sorry, I know we just worked together for a day...
I'm not saying no, Mu Xing. It's just I've yet to fully recover. I wouldn't make a good teacher...
Ah, stupid me. Almost forgot you're still sick.
Why do you want to learn martial arts?
Cos I wanna be a legendary warrior! I love stories about you! But ... I'm just some burdo-mucker...
Of course I like burdos but... I don't know how to put it...
Sorry about this. You took on work to get it off your mind, yet I went and brought it up again...
After this entire day, I've decided to put off the thinking.
We can work hard together. Perhaps you'll find the answers quicker than I do.
Yeah! Oh, it's getting pretty late. Let's end our daily work here! Dismissed! Grab some rest!
Yes, sir.
I'm just a reservist who almost died on the battlefield...
Tartpeppers ... for digestion...

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe rescues Mu Xing but learns the kid was trying to protect the burdenbeast he raised for years and fearlessly tried to fight the waterlamps. Ye Minghe ponders.

lines.text: Did you get injured?
I'm good... I-I'm so sorry, Mister. I didn't know there were so many waterlamps in the hills.
Why apologize?
You're still sick, but I...
Raven Smol? Is that the burdo's name?
Yeah. I'm such a lousy kid. If you weren't here, I probably...
No, you did your best to protect Raven Smol. It was very brave. The waterlamps were actually scared.
Really?
I prolly felt a little scared at that moment ... but I just can't stand there and do nothing!
You okay, Mister? Why are you so quiet?
Thank you, Mu Xing.
You're being so weird, Mister...
You saved people's lives, but you always said you were the one being helped.
Just working up a sweat. I'm totally fine.
And look, you're the burdenbeast expert. Fighting, though? That's where I can be somewhat useful to our burdo-master, right?
Thank you, Mister. You saved me and Raven Smol.
Really. Were you afraid back then?
Raven Smol is the first burdo I raised. I took care of it when it just learned to walk.
I'm just some burdenbeast farmer kid. I guess there aren't many things I could care about...
Maybe I was talking weird... Let's just say I'm seeing a few things more clearly.
Nuli? Why are you here?
(Unhappily shakes her neck)
Alright, Mu Xing. Take Raven Smol home. I have something to say to this old girl.
Okay. And don't forget to swing by Granny Qin's place. She said she made an awesome pot roast!

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe opens up his thoughts to Nuli. He's not familiar with the village but he has decided to stay to recuperate and to help the villagers who gave him a place to stay. Several years go by.

lines.text: Simmered down?
(Refuses to respond)
So, how long did you stay at Pan'an Village after that?
In the war in the north, I was too heavily injured. Rushing back to Hongshan would accomplish little...
Morning, Mister! I'm foraging good feed near the village entrance. Wanna join me?
Sorry, Lil Mu. Ah Zheng needs to patch up a wall and I promised I'd help.
Heheh, super handyman Minghe has been taken! Great. I'll catch you later.
Pretty peaceful, isn't it?
Well, old girl, did we ever stay at one place for this long, like we have here?
(Shakes her neck)
Yeah. Never did. Till now.
Did I ever spend so much time ... without a weapon in my hand?
(Shakes her neck)
Rare. I know.
But these past few months, I've spent my days doing farm work, like repairing beast pens, feeding burdos, foraging herbs, and tilling the earth...
I never realized I could be so clumsy. What the villagers did easily, it took me a dozen tries before I could manage.
You might find it funny. Even marching is easier than this... It got me so tired I almost forgot how to grip a sword.
When I picked it up again, I felt that ... something was different...
(Confused breathing)
Maybe it's because I'm not fully healed yet...
My body will probably need more time to heal. Things will get busy in the village. I want to help, in whatever way I can.
Sorry, old girl. You have to stick around some more.
Quite a while.
Lil Mu. Lulu. Granny Qin... Being a friend of the Pan'an villagers is easy. Leaving them ... was difficult.
Several years flew past, and I barely noticed...
That's quite a while... Something must have happened when you decided to leave.
Keep looking, Endmin... That part is arriving soon.
Mister Minghe, we got a fresh harvest. Swing by for a few!
This ain't easy, you know. Plenty of villages got their orchards blighted and spoiled.
Thank you, missus. I'll have a few when I got the time.
Morning, Master Ye. Feeling lucky with angling?
Sure. But let's choose a better spot this time. One without Aggeloid interference.
Hey, that's why I need you around.

scenes.summary: An Ankhor suddenly falls at the village entrance. To protect the villagers, Ye Minghe, who has not fought for quite a while, draws his weapon.

lines.text: All done. This wall should be fine now.
Thank you so much. It took me ages and I still couldn't figure it out.
You were supposed to rest and get better. Somewhere down the road you started helping us in everything.
An-Ankhor?! Here?
There isn't just one Ankhor! It's too dangerous! Hey! We should wait for reinforcements —
Of course not. It's not like when we first met... I'm here to give you a boost.
The Endministrator said you'd ... forget about them, till it's time for you to pick them up again.
At first I found the words illogical and couldn't figure it out... *sigh* But this might be the day it happens.
Many thanks.
Yes. Near the village entrance. I'm heading over.
Your weapons. Use them well.
Come on, Ah Zheng. I'm just doing my part.
I thought I've been an honorary Pan'an villager for quite a while.
Ah, silly me... Of course you're one of us!
Please, surgeon, did you run all the way here just to stop me...?
You hands aren't rusty, are they?
Good girl, that's the perfect entry.

scenes.summary: Young Ye Minghe finally understood what your previous self wanted him to master. He has learned to swing a blade not to prove his rank or skills, but to protect his friends. Having gained his epiphany, Ye decides to embark on his journey. Si removes you and Ye Minghe from the scroll, knowing that both of you have seen the past.

lines.text: Good people, thank you for everything over the years. Take care and stay safe.
My first stop was supposed to be Dijiang — to pay you a visit. That was the promise we'd made.
But I knew you'd come around. I needed only to wait. So for the years that followed, I roamed across the lands of Talos-II.
I submitted an application to HAS. For any emergency within my reach, I did my best to help...
Lady Si cares deeply for you. It's only normal for her to treat me with suspicions.
The show is over. If there is any comment, you can tell me outside.
"Zeroth Directive"?
Si didn't look too happy.
This "strike"...
Endmin, I hope my epiphany didn't take too long...
Just look at this. What a powerful strike... Mister Minghe, have you always been this awesome?
No. But I have to thank you... And no, I am not being weird this time.
Perhaps for the next season, you can till the gash into new farmland.
Mister Minghe, are you ... going to leave Pan'an Village?
Yes. I figured it out. Now it's time for me to leave.
Mu Xing, it doesn't matter if you wanna raise your burdos or be a legendary warrior.
You don't need others telling you what to do.
We will meet again ... and treat this as our promise.
To defend the lad who kept me company for all those years, I copied the move you unleashed to save my life.
Not for my rank or my duty, nor for any martial achievement. It was done for such a small purpose.
But where there's a purpose like this, there's one who can make that move.
A return to simplicity... That's such a rare experience.
After leaving Pan'an Village, where did you go?
But halfway during the trip, I learned that you were in deep slumber.
Military deployment and marches took me to many places. But when I visited them again, they felt fresh and different.
And then Tianshi Tan told Lady Si to seek me out, for matters concerning the "Zeroth Directive".
Sorry, I've messed up this place.
Just make up your mind, then give it your all...

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe thanks you formally for saving his life and for giving him the chance to think about the reasons for fighting all those years ago. Both of you make a new promise to face all challenges and protect the lands together.

lines.text: Endmin, are you alright?
Did Si just...?
It's a work of Lady Si. What's real and what's just a drawing, it's up to her.
No matter what, I need to thank her properly. The story about how we first met isn't an easy one to tell...
I mastered that move of yours ... and fulfilled the promise we made.
Now I can finally say this to you in person: Thank you.
You actually figured it out on your own.
When you decided to stay at Pan'an Village, you were destined to unleash that move.
As for now, there's no need to rush its return.
Endmin, you...
Hongshan and Endfield will be working together more closely than ever before. We will face greater challenges than we did ten years ago.
Maybe next time, I'll be the one who needs your help.
I await your command.
I wonder, where did Nuli go?
We had quite an encounter. Nuli probably scampered off... Don't worry. She can easily find me, and you.
Also ... what happened to that burdenbeast? The one that's an Ink Spirit?
That might be Lady Si's little prank. We should ask Mu Xing about it.
We should, but this place is a little far from where we met Mu Xing...
If you're not busy, let's just walk to his place.
Hah. Sure.
Endmin, if you have time, we can head back for another look.
Of course. Or maybe we'll run into another Pan'an Village along the way there.
Indeed... The world we've built ... has endless possibilities.

options: Still, thanks to Si's painting, I remembered a lot of things as well.
Did she do all this to help you?

lines.text: So that's what happened...
Mu Xing must be that Tianshi we met before. No wonder he asked you to look for the burdenbeast.
Yes, he is Mu Xing. Without him, I would have had trouble settling down at Pan'an Village.
How long did you stay there? I thought Nuli was impatient.
Hah. That's true. She got a little feisty when the novelty wore off.
Getting her to calm down wasn't easy. In fact, Mu Xing had a hand in that too...
He was an excellent teacher...

scenes.summary: The beast pen is repaired. Mu Xing invites Ye Minghe to care for the burdenbeasts.

lines.text: It's not that bad. I say it's solid work!
I don't think burdenbeasts would appreciate this oddly-shaped pen...
You're not a burdenbeast. You know nothing about burdo-joy.
Ah. I spent too much time on this. Gotta take care of the herd.
Still strong enough, Mister Minghe? What do you say we go meet the Herd?
Oh. Sure.
Don't worry. My burdos are nicer than Angry Nuli. Plus, I'm a real burdo-master and I can teach you.
Greetings. Have you seen Lil Mu?
Hmm. I think I did... Saw the kid going down the trail.
Thank you.

scenes.summary: The "repaired" beast pen is not perfect. Ye Minghe realizes his combat skills are hardly useful in the village. He sorts himself out and asks Lulu the Carpenter to lead him along.

lines.text: Mister Minghe, is this your first beast pen repair? It's pretty good.
Lulu, got a feeling this pen is gonna collapse in the wind...
Any burdo sleeping in this rickety pen is gonna get nightmares...
Shut it, Mu Xing. The job's not half bad.
Sorry. I shouldn't be making fun of injured people.
I guess I wasn't much help...
Heheh, it's alright.
You're a great soldier, Mister Minghe. They said you soloed a thousand Aggeloi. But skills with spear and blade...
...they're not really needed in beast pen repairs.
Miss Lulu, can you teach me beast pen repairs...? I'll do a better job.
Sure. We gotta be fast, though. The burdenbeasts need cover from rain.
Let's do it.
(Deliberate snort of disdain)
What is it, girl?
Mister Minghe, have you seen lil Mu Xing?
Lil Mu rushed out of the beast pen early in the morning. He hasn't returned, and he isn't answering our calls...
(One of the burdos is missing. Maybe that's why...)
No. Is something wrong?
Don't worry. Mu Xing is a good kid.
That's exactly why I'm so worried...
Rest easy, missus. I'll find the lad.
Watch me. Burdo patting's an art. Don't go too hard, too soft, too fast, or too slow...
"Don't go too hard, too soft, too fast, or too slow..."
Different pats give them different feels, you know.
Do it a few more times. You'll learn the difference! Try again!
Deja vu...
The villagers are in danger...
Looking good and happy. Fixing things for the people again?
And it seems you're getting better at repairs. You've gone beyond burdenbeast pens.
Actually I'm still not very good at plenty of things.
There, there. We'll get our chance, girl.
Is Nuli doing okay?
It's me, really. Held the reins a little tight in Wuling. Old girl really wants to gallop and feel the wind.
Sure. And I'd be glad to have you along. If it's you, Nuli won't mind carrying one more.

options: Maybe the Valley will do Nuli good...
I think I got just the place for her...

lines.text: GO AWAY, YOU BUGS!
Have no fear.
Do I strengthen this part...?
"Don't go too hard, too soft, too fast, or too slow..."
Doing good, Mister!
Everyone! Get back!
Mister Minghe! Watch out! That Aggelos...!
Th-there's people trapped at the village gates. Mu Xing is there too...
Got it. Look for a safe place to hide.
